finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.untrusted_source: The password is read from a file named 'secret'.
finding.sink: The password is used in the libcurl options.
finding.trigger: If the 'secret' file contains malicious content, it could be used to inject commands.
finding.assumptions: The 'secret' file is writable by an attacker and contains malicious content.

finding.title: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
finding.untrusted_source: The email content is hardcoded and not sanitized.
finding.sink: The email content is sent to the SMTP server.
finding.trigger: If the email content contains malicious scripts, they could be executed by the recipient.
finding.assumptions: The recipient's email client does not sanitize the email content.

finding.title: Insecure Storage of Sensitive Data
finding.untrusted_source: The password is read from a file named 'secret'.
finding.sink: The password is stored in a string variable.
finding.trigger: If the 'secret' file is accessible by unauthorized users, the password could be exposed.
finding.assumptions: The 'secret' file has appropriate permissions and is not accessible by unauthorized users.
